title: Grandma's Backyard
text: Every weekend, my grandma invites us to her backyard for a cookout. My little brother loves to play on the seesaw and the sandbox near the sunflowers. Grandpa always sets up a birdhouse and fills the birdbath with fresh water. After lunch, we watch the sunset from the front porch and tell each other stories about our classmates and homework.
